name: tkr-run-progress
description: Live pane and status line for the newest tickmarkr run, plus the release chain's CI and publish stages

stateRoots.title: Run state roots
stateRoots.description: Comma-separated .tickmarkr folders to read runs from; ~ and globs expand. The newest run across all of them shows.

releaseRoots.title: Release folders
releaseRoots.description: Comma-separated release folders holding a ci-watch.log; ~ and globs expand. The newest log drives the release card. Empty hides it.

marks.title: Harness marks
marks.description: glyph (default) draws a shape after each harness's logo in any font. devicons draws the real logo from the Devicons icon font (devicons.io); add Devicons to your terminal's font list first, or the marks draw as empty boxes.
